body:
Thanks for sending an issue! Please fill in the following template to help quickly solve your problem.

### Describe the current behavior / 问题描述 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
算子部分用例精度失败
### Environment / 环境信息 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
【测试环境】：Ascend950 EVB环境
【测试版本】：V100R001C10 20260618商分版本
### Steps to reproduce the issue / 重现步骤 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
【重现步骤】：
1、aclnn-AscendC仓：https://codehub-y.huawei.com/w00800330/TuringAclnn/files?ref=master&filePath=op%2Faclnn_fuzz
2、cd TuringAclnn-master/op/aclnn_fuzz/Aclnn; bash build_david.sh；
3、./train_performance_aclnn_new.sh --sheet_name=level0 --exec_mode=npu_off --version=david_EVB --build=False --execute_loop_times=1 --timeout=3600 --use_bin=false --determin_method=false --determin_check=false --py_version=py310 --ti=0-43 --conda_name=CI_py310_aclnn --op_name=aclnnFusedMatmul --case_name=op_summary_opensoraplan_train_3,op_summary_opensoraplan_train_65
### Describe the expected behavior / 预期结果 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
【预期结果】：批跑的全量用例功能精度pass
### Related log / screenshot / 日志 / 截图 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
![image.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7665709/c3fbfc1c-a87b-4d41-ad1f-9aec038e8848/image.png 'image.png')
